readme.summary: Exceptionally well-documented README with clear installation paths, thorough configuration options, visual screenshots, and a troubleshooting section covering the most common issues.
readme.top_issue: Troubleshooting section is minimal with only 3 issues covered; edge cases like Node version incompatibilities or Windows-specific problems are not addressed.

injection_risks.description: Use of child_process.exec() with user input from 'git config -l' command
